title: 5‑BR 30A Santa Rosa Beach Vacation Home with Beach Access
meta_description: Stay at Lynda Lou's, a spacious 5-BR, 4.5-bath 30A Santa Rosa Beach vacation home with private pool and beach access. Accommodates 12 guests.
description_expanded: If staying close to the beach and even closer to everything 30A offers is on your wish list, Lynda Lou’s delivers. Located on the peaceful west end of Santa Rosa Beach, this spacious five bedroom, four and a half bath home sits just 0.6 miles from Ed Walline Public Beach Access. With room for up to 12 guests, it’s a great spot for families or friends looking to enjoy sun filled days and laid back nights near the Gulf. Hop on the complimentary six seater golf cart to explore nearby attractions like Gulf Place Town Center, where you’ll find local dining, live music, and boutique shopping.Inside, the home is designed for comfort and connection. The main living area features plush seating, a large TV, and natural light streaming through glass doors that open to your private heated pool, perfect for afternoon dips or lounging. The kitchen is stocked with stainless steel appliances and essentials like a blender, coffee maker, toaster, and microwave. The oversized island seats six and is perfect for snacks or drinks. The dining table is ideal for shared meals or game nights. Also on the main level: a king suite with private bath, plus a laundry room and half bath for added ease.Upstairs, guests can relax in the second living area with a sleeper sofa, great for movie nights or quiet mornings. The upper level includes four bedrooms, a second king suite with a private balcony and full bath, two queen guest rooms, and a bunk room that’s perfect for kids. The layout gives everyone room to unwind after a day of beach fun.Sleeping Arrangements:First Floor* Primary Bedroom: King Bed, TV, ensuite bathroom (Tub + Walk in Shower)Second Floor* 2nd Primary Bedroom: King Bed, TV, balcony access, Private Bathroom* Guest Room: Queen Bed, TV, Private Bathroom* Guest Room: Queen Bed, TV, Shared Bathroom* Bunk Room: Twin over Twin Bunks* 2nd Living Area: Full size pull out sofa bedOutdoors, enjoy the private pool (heated seasonally), fire up the grill for a backyard cookout, or hop on the golf cart for a breezy ride to the beach. Whether you’re sipping coffee by the pool or walking to the nearest ice cream shop after dinner, Lynda Lou’s sets the scene for a laid-back getaway near the heart of 30A.What’s NearbyLocated on the west end of 30A, this home places you within easy reach of some of Santa Rosa Beach’s most loved local spots. Walk, or take the golf cart to Gulf Place Town Center, a hub of live music, art galleries, and locally owned boutiques. Craving something casual? Try Pizza by the Sea or grab fresh Gulf seafood and cocktails with a view at Shunk Gulley Oyster Bar. Cool off with handcrafted sweets at Pecan Jacks Ice Cream, or ease into your morning with a brew from Sunrise Coffee Co.For dinner, enjoy a relaxed meal at Local Catch, take in sunset views from Vue on 30a, or enjoy Italian favorites at Mimmo’s Ristorante. With everything from beachside bites to evening dining just minutes away, every day offers a chance to explore the flavors and character that make this area a true 30A gem.Your stay at Lynda Lou's comes with Xplorie’s best activities! Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!Additional Information:* Snowbird Friendly!* Sorry, no pets allowed.* Parking for 3 cars with no street parking.* The private pool can be heated seasonally for an additional fee.A starter set of amenities is provided: The kitchen includes paper towels, a sponge, dish soap, dishwasher pods, kitchen wipes, trash liners, and laundry pods. Each bathroom has toilet paper, facial and bath soaps, body wash, shampoo, and conditioner. Towels include one body towel and washcloth per guest, plus two hand towels per bathroom.
